verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no batch or bulk-update API, no bulk Dashboard actions, and no way to act on many subscriptions, invoices or customers at once. The only multi-item capability is the subscription migration toolkit (importing subscriptions from third-party billing systems). That is a one-time import feature that belongs to a separate migration story, so it does not count as general bulk operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
